I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message: the site was Southgate.

Priyanka's posts in #inc-tansley-carrier-api from 3 Sep 2025 say Southgate dispatch had unlabelled totes stacked by door 4 while labels weren't printing. Once the outage was fixed, Southgate cleared the backlog. I couldn't find a street address or any other details for the Southgate site in that channel or in the shared files Tobias can see.
